boundary: Compared with the budgets the operator FROZE on 2026-11-16 (blueprint section 10: p95 frame interval at most 20 ms on the smooth tier, local feedback under 100 ms). PERF-01 earns points only on the named desktop, headed, on the build that ships, before any visual-load change. Keydown to the next frame is measured in the page, not from the key to the screen. GPU time is unavailable unless the browser offers its timer extension, and an unavailable counter is never read as zero cost. Draw calls are the face's own count, not VRAM. A headless run, or one on the Vite dev server, is a smoke, not the named desktop profile.
